content: Vihaan Patel reached out to check the status of his health policy and learned from agent Anjali Desai that it expired on the 10th of the month. Anjali explained the difference between reinstating the current policy versus getting a new one and resent a previously sent email with instructions. Vihaan opted to reinstate his policy and asked for guidance through the process.

action_items: Guide the customer through the policy reinstatement process
